fullPassage: Steve Jobs used analogy to get people to embrace the new technology. Before computers, people worked in a physical world. We used paper and pens and physical file folders and so on. The idea of working in a virtual world was radically different. Or at least seemed radically different. What Jobs understood was that a physical office was fundamentally similar to a virtual office. To win over the masses, Jobs drew strong analogies between the traditional workplace and the new, unfamiliar virtual workplace. In the pre-computer workplace, when ideas were written on paper it was called a document. When those documents needed to be stored they were put in a folder. And those folders were kept on a desk. Documents, folders, and desktops are the terms we use in our virtual work because Steve Jobs understood that __________ would make the new technology easier to understand. The parallels between the physical and virtual workplace now seem obvious.

questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 유비(익숙한 것 비유) → 새로운 것 이해 촉진
det.analysis:
① 본질적으로 같다 — 너무 단정적
② 익숙한 것에 비유 → 이해 촉진 ←정답
③ 완전히 바꿈 — 본문 주제 아님
④ 변화 없다 — 사실과 다름

ch: 가상 세계와 물리적 세계는 본질적으로 같다.
익숙한 것에 비유하면 새로운 것을 쉽게 이해할 수 있다.
기술 발전은 전통적 업무 방식을 완전히 바꾸었다.
문서 관리 시스템은 컴퓨터 등장 전후로 변화가 없다.

questions.passage: Steve Jobs used analogy to get people to embrace the new technology. Before computers, people worked in a physical world. We used paper and pens and physical file folders and so on. The idea of working in a virtual world was radically different. Or at least seemed radically different. What Jobs understood was that a physical office was fundamentally similar to a virtual office. To win over the masses, Jobs drew strong analogies between the traditional workplace and the new, unfamiliar virtual workplace. In the pre-computer workplace, when ideas were written on paper __________. When those documents needed to be stored they were put in a folder. And those folders were kept on a desk. Documents, folders, and desktops are the terms we use in our virtual work because Steve Jobs understood that __________ would make the new technology easier to understand. The parallels between the physical and virtual workplace now seem obvious.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 맞게 영작하시오. (영어로)
"종이에 쓰이면 그것은 문서라고 불렸다"
[조건] (1) a, called, document, it, was를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 5단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 그것은 문서라고 불렸다
det.analysis: it(그것은) was called(불렸다) a document(문서) = 5단어 수동태
